title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
summary: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
summary: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
summary: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.
